name: trellis2-birefnet
note: BiRefNet's matting model in GGUF for trellis-cli, the one file bootstrap_pixal3d.py takes from this repo (it flattens q8/birefnet.gguf into the models folder). The repo's card says 'see the source model'; trellis.cpp's README names ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet (MIT, not BRIA's RMBG-2.0) as the background remover it converts. The generator cuts pictures out with BiRefNet-lite first, so trellis-cli keeps their alpha.

name: birefnet-general-lite
note: BiRefNet-lite through rembg (224 MB, rembg's published md5 4fab47adc4ff364be1713e97b7e66334), the cut-out every picture takes before Pixal3D (image_to_3dlab/matte.py); rembg looks for it as birefnet-general-lite.onnx in U2NET_HOME.
